user_request: current branch 01a18038-5407-7fe2-abe0-48a7f9e77c3e; expand domain directional candidates, 3figures with actual-h spectral dependency stop
eligibility: both math and biology >=5 discovery documents with positive native activation
score: single-feature per-document mean native contribution, including zero
direction: sign(discovery_auc-0.5); zero direction retained in background, not selected
ordering: descending abs(discovery_auc-0.5), ascending feature_id; no heldout tie-break
expanded_definition: directional discriminability candidate, NOT original R04 activation-rate-ratio>=2 candidate
main_display_rule: global first16 eligible ranks, not forced8+8

bootstrap.unit: document, independently resample20math and20bio with replacement
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile, pointwise exploratory intervals; no significance declarations

usage_statistics: per document: counts/160; sum(z)*native_decoder_norm/counts if counts>0 else NA; sum(z)*native_decoder_norm/160; group means over documents, conditional intensity excludes NA; pooled intensity also separate
differences: math minus bio for each usage statistic; direction-fixed AUC minus0.5; discovery vs heldout AUC difference; intervals in tables
display_scaling: hit%; intensity and mean contribution divide per-feature discovery token contribution RMS; original native values in tables; no recomputation from heldout

random.universe: same-dictionary eligible coordinates excluding every member of current matched group
random.sample: exact number per joint bin, no replacement within draw; no fallback; insufficient bin makes full set NA; no forced candidate retention
random.comparison: descriptive heldout mean direction-fixed AUC and frequency composition, not p-value for selection or causal mechanism; spectral comparison NOT RUN without real h

separate_hooks.SAE: block27 MLP input after native post_attention_layernorm, raw model coordinates
separate_hooks.CC: block27 residual-post before final global norm, raw model coordinates

pca.centering: one pooled discovery mean; equal math/bio, equal document,160tokens/document
pca.bin_rule: contiguous64directions each, final remainder if needed
pca.unit_decoder_projection: squared unit native decoder dot PC; full sum1; missing residual explicit if truncated
pca.domain_mean_difference: difference of means of document-average real h, project onto frozen discovery basis
pca.reference_variance: real-h spectral-band variance, discovery and frozen-coordinate dev/heldout
pca.activation_weighted: optional separate sum of individual squared contributions; excludes cross terms, not total variance

display_examples: top16 strongest discovery-ranked eachdirection illustrative; original R04 examples retained as counter; any token example is descriptive not heldout confirmation
limits: not model necessity, semantic natural clusters, frequency cause, physical long-range mechanism
